title: The Judgment on Jehoiakim
description: Jeremiah condemns King Jehoiakim for building his palace through injustice, exploiting workers without pay, and seeking personal gain through oppression and bloodshed. The prophet predicts that he will be buried like a donkey, dragged away, and cast outside the gates of Jerusalem [ref:Jer 22:13-19|Jeremiah 22:13-19].
